name: Prajogo Pangestu
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (1996-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2026)
forbes_bio: Son of a rubber trader, Prajogo Pangestu got his start in the timber business in the late 1970s.
His company Barito Pacific Timber went public in 1993 and changed its name to Barito Pacific after cutting back on its timber business in 2007.
In 2007, Barito Pacific acquired 70% of listed petrochemicals firm Chandra Asri, which spun off its  subsidiary Chandra Daya Investasi to trade on the Indonesia Stock Exchange in 2025.
In 2011 Chandra Asri merged with Tri Polyta Indonesia and became one of the country's largest integrated petrochemicals producers. In the same year Thaioil acquired a 15% stake in Chandra Asri.
After taking his coal mining firm Petrindo Jaya Kreasi public in 2023, Pangestu listed renewable energy arm, Barito Renewables Energy, later in the year.
forbes_facts: Chandra Asri Petrochemical teamed with French tire manufacturer Michelin in 2015 to develop a synthetic rubber plant in Indonesia.
In 2022, the Pangestu family office took control of thermal energy producer Star Energy, by acquiring a 33% stake  from Thailand's BCPG for $440 million.

name: Arvid Lunnemark
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Hurun Global (2026); Hurun Global U40 (2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2025-2026)
forbes_bio: Arvid Lunnemark cofounded Cursor, the maker of a popular AI code editing tool, with three friends from MIT in 2022.
The company was acquired by SpaceX for $60 billion in August 2026. Forbes estimates that each Cursor cofounder received shares of the rocket maker worth $2.4 billion at the deal's closing.
Before the SpaceX acquisition, Cursor claimed to have more than $1 billion in annualized revenue, making it one of the fastest growing AI startups.
Today, millions of software developers at enterprises like Nvidia, Adobe, Uber and Shopify use Cursor to generate and edit chunks of code.
Originally from Sweden, Lunnemark left Cursor in 2025 to launch a new startup called Integrous Research, which is focused on developing systems for safer AI.
A former math olympiad champion, Lunnemark did internships in quantitative trading at Jane Street and software engineering at Stripe before cofounding Cursor.

name: Jim Justice II
forbes_bio: In November 2016, West Virginians elected the state's only billionaire, Jim Justice, to be their new governor.
He ran as a Democrat, but six months after becoming governor, Justice switched back to being a Republican.
Justice inherited a coal business from his dad and still owns coal mines in five states.
He's had a hard time paying the bills: since 2016, he's been hit with over $10 million in court orders and $13 million in tax-related liens.
Virginia's Department of Mines, Minerals and Energy estimates that Justice's coal companies face $200 million in reclamation liabilities.
forbes_facts: Justice purchased the historic Greenbrier Resort in West Virginia out of bankruptcy in 2009, giving it a $250 million facelift.
